components.name: ShadQuestionnaire
components.description: ToolJet UI 2.0 multi-step questionnaire, one question at a time: a 'Question 2 of 5' progress bar, the prompt and description, answer cards with a letter (or number) shortcut, and Previous, Skip (optional questions), Next and Submit. items: [{ name, prompt, description, required, type: 'single' | 'multiple' | 'text', choices: ['Label'] or [{ label, value, description }], other: true or { label, placeholder } (a free-text Other answer), placeholder (text), multiline: false (a one-line text answer: a name, an email) }]. A required question blocks Next with an error until answered. Exposes answers ({ [name]: value, multiple as an array, Other as its text }), currentIndex, currentItem and isComplete; onStepChanged on every move, onSubmit with the answers (run the save query there). After submit it shows completeTitle and completeText. Actions reset() and goTo(index or name). defaultAnswers restores saved answers. Height: grows with the question (about 440px for four choices, 160px plus 58px per choice)

authoringHints.styles: Every style falls back to the app theme, so set only what the design needs to blend in (its accent, surfaces, borders and text colours), taking colours from the app theme or brand, never the defaults of another product. Radii and sizes are px. Styles are the way to restyle a pack widget: a cssClass only takes effect with workspace Custom styles, and Tailwind class names the pack does not already use are not compiled, so do not rely on either; for a one-off visual a style cannot express, use an Html component. Bind loadingState to the query's isLoading (each widget draws a skeleton or spinner in its own shape); tooltip shows on hover.
authoringHints.usage: A step-by-step questionnaire: intake, onboarding, a survey, a triage or an assessment, one question at a time with progress, Previous, Skip (optional questions, not the last) and Next, in place of a long Form or a Tabs wizard. items is the question list: [{ name, prompt, description, required, type 'single' | 'multiple' | 'text', choices: ['Label'] or [{ label, value, description }], other: true or { label, placeholder } for a typed 'Other' answer, placeholder, multiline: false for a one-line text answer (a name, an email) }]. A required question blocks Next until answered (an Other picked but left empty does too). components.<q>.answers is keyed by item name: single gives the choice's value (or the typed Other text), multiple an array (Other text last: join it, [].concat(a.equipment || []).join(', '), for a text column), text a string. Run the save query on onSubmit, reading the answers there; the widget then shows completeTitle and completeText (completeTitle can bind to an answer: 'You are all set, ' + components.<q>.answers.preferred_name), with an 'Edit answers' link back. onStepChanged with currentIndex and currentItem.name can drive a side panel ('Why we ask'); the reset action starts a new response (a 'Start another' button shown while isComplete), goTo jumps. defaultAnswers restores saved answers. Write prompts as questions and choices as short labels with a one-line description. It draws its own card (surface 'card'; 'plain' inside a card or a dialog) and fits each question's height (dynamicHeight, on by default): give it the height of a typical question (about 160px plus 58px per choice) and nothing pinned right under it that would be pushed down.
